About Me

Meet your developer, Charles!

Passionate developer building for the web.

Charles Writes:

I'm a web developer who enjoys turning ideas into websites that feel clear, responsive, and easy to use.

Over the years, I've worked on a range of projects — from simple websites to interactive web experiences — always focusing on clean layouts, smooth interactions, and details that make a difference.

Web development for me isn't just about writing code, it's a way to turn ideas into something people can actually use. I aim to create websites that feel functional, engaging, and purposeful.

Services

What I offer

Seven ways
I can help.

Websites, WordPress, interfaces, automation and everyday tech support. Scroll to see each one.

Scroll
About Website DevelopmentChapter 01

Websites that work on every screen.

From a simple landing page to a full web app, I build responsive, fast and functional websites with clean, readable code.

You tell me what the site needs to do. I plan it, build it, test it on phones and desktops, and hand it over ready to use.

  • Responsive
  • Forms & features
  • Clean code
Request this service
About WordPress DevelopmentChapter 02

A site you can edit yourself.

I create and customize WordPress websites with themes and plugins that fit your brand, so the site looks right from day one.

Pages are built to be easy to update. Change a photo, add a post or edit a price without calling a developer every time.

  • Custom themes
  • Plugins
  • Easy editing
Request this service
About UI ImplementationChapter 03

From design to pixel-perfect.

Got a Figma file or a sketch? I turn designs and ideas into clean, working web interfaces that match what you imagined.

Spacing, type, colors and states are handled with care, and every screen is checked on mobile, tablet and desktop.

  • Figma to code
  • Pixel-accurate
  • Mobile-friendly
Request this service
About Website CustomizationChapter 04

Make your current site better.

Already have a website that is almost right? I improve its layout, add new features and fix what is not working.

No need to start over. I work with what you have and change only what makes the biggest difference.

  • New features
  • Layout updates
  • Fixes
Request this service
About Excel & VBA AutomationChapter 05

Stop doing it by hand.

Repetitive spreadsheet work eats hours. I build formulas, macros and reports that do the boring parts for you.

Tell me the steps you repeat every day or week, and I will turn them into a button, a clean report or a workflow that runs itself.

  • Macros
  • Formulas
  • Reports & dashboards
Request this service
About IT SupportChapter 06

Stuck? Let's fix it.

Basic troubleshooting and technical assistance for the everyday problems that slow you down.

I explain what went wrong in plain words, fix it, and show you how to avoid it next time.

  • Troubleshooting
  • Setup & config
  • Plain-language help
Request this service
About Website MaintenanceChapter 07

Keep it updated. Keep it running.

Websites need regular care. I update content, plugins and features, and fix small problems before they become big ones.

Leave the upkeep to me and keep your attention on your business. Your site stays fresh, tidy and working.

  • Updates
  • Bug fixes
  • Ongoing improvements
Request this service
